How to run it
One round: do each exercise once, in order, and you're done. Rest as you need between them.
Main Circuit
Goblet squat and reach
3 sets8-12 repsAny kit~5kg
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Hold a weight at the chest, feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out.

Movement: Sit down into a squat and, at the bottom, reach the weight forward to help you sit upright, then draw it back to the chest and stand tall.

Focus: Keep the knees in line with the middle toes and the heels down. Use the reach to stay upright rather than tipping forward, and squat only as deep as the knees allow.

Stiff-leg deadlift – BB
3 sets8-10 repsBarbell~22.5kg
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Stand tall with the bar at the thighs, feet hip-width, knees almost straight but not locked, shoulders back, core braced.

Movement: Push the hips back and lower the bar down the front of the legs with the knees kept still, feeling a strong hamstring stretch, then drive the hips forward to stand tall.

Focus: Keep the back flat throughout, never rounded, and only go as low as the flat back allows. With the knees nearly straight the stretch is strong, so control the range and keep the bar close to the legs.

Overhead press – Arnold
3 sets8-12 repsDB~3kg
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Sit or stand tall, dumbbells held in front at shoulder height, palms facing you, elbows down, ribs down.

Movement: Press overhead while rotating the palms to face forward, straightening the arms, then reverse the rotation as you lower back down.

Focus: Keep the ribs down and the lower back neutral through the press and rotation. Keep the shoulders down, control the twist, and stay within a comfortable shoulder range.

Reverse fly – single arm
3 sets8-12 each sideDB~3kg
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Hinge forward with a flat back, a light dumbbell in one hand hanging below the chest, elbow softly bent, other hand supporting.

Movement: Raise the arm out to the side to shoulder height, squeezing the shoulder blade, then lower under control.

Focus: Keep a soft elbow bend and lead with the back of the hand, squeezing the shoulder blade. Keep the back flat and don't swing or shrug, using a light weight.

Reverse lunge – bodyweight
3 sets8 each sideBodyweightBodyweight
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Stand tall, feet hip-width, hands on hips or out for balance.

Movement: Step one foot back and lower until both knees are bent towards right angles, back knee towards the floor, then drive through the front heel to return to standing.

Focus: Keep the front knee over the ankle, not drifting past the toes or caving in, and the torso tall. Lower under control, and push back up through the front heel.

Elbow plank – arm reach
3 sets20s each sideMatBodyweight
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Set up in a forearm plank, straight line from head to heels, core and glutes braced.

Movement: Keeping the hips level, reach one arm forward off the floor, hold briefly, return, then the other.

Focus: Keep the hips level and square as you reach, resisting any twist. Keep the ribs down and the core braced, and keep the reach controlled so the line stays straight.

Note any changes on the main lifts. Tap Show pictures or Show description on a move to see how it's done.
How to run it
One round: do each exercise once, in order, and you're done. Rest as you need between them.
Main Circuit
Sumo deadlift
3 sets6-10 repsBarbell~17.5kg
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Stand with a wide stance, toes turned out, the bar over mid-foot. Push the hips back and down to grip the bar inside your legs, arms straight, chest up, back flat, shoulders over or just behind the bar.

Movement: Drive the floor away through the legs, opening the hips and keeping the bar close, until you stand tall with the hips fully extended. Push the hips back to lower the bar under control along the same path.

Focus: Keep the back flat throughout and the chest up, never let the back round. Push the knees out in line with the middle toes and take the strain in the legs and hips, not the lower back. Keep the bar close to your body the whole way.

Pendlay row
3 sets6-8 repsBarbell~22.5kg
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Hinge to a flat back with the torso near parallel, barbell on the floor, overhand grip, core braced.

Movement: Pull the bar explosively from the floor to the lower chest, then lower it back to the floor and reset each rep.

Focus: Keep the back flat and parallel throughout, never rising or rounding as you pull. Lead with the elbows, squeeze the shoulder blades, and reset the bar on the floor between reps.

Single arm overhead press
3 sets8-12 each sideAny kit~5kg
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Stand tall, a weight at one shoulder, feet hip-width, ribs down, core braced against the offset load.

Movement: Press the weight overhead until the arm is straight, then lower back to the shoulder under control.

Focus: Keep the ribs down and resist leaning away from the weight, keeping the torso upright. Keep the shoulder down away from the ear, and press within a comfortable range.

Walking lunges – suitcase
3 sets8 each sideAny kitModerate
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Stand tall with a weight in one hand at your side like a suitcase, feet hip-width, ribs down, core braced, with space ahead to walk into.

Movement: Step forward into a lunge, lowering until both knees bend towards right angles, then drive through the front heel and bring the back foot through into the next lunge, holding the weight steady at your side throughout. Load one side for the set, then swap.

Focus: Resist the pull towards the weighted side, keeping the shoulders and hips level and the torso tall. Keep the front knee over the ankle, brace hard so you don't lean, and step under control.

Curl and overhead extension – BB
3 sets8-12 repsBarbellModerate
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Stand tall holding a bar at the thighs with an underhand grip, elbows pinned to the sides, ribs down, core braced.

Movement: Curl the bar to the shoulders, press it overhead, lower it behind the head by bending the elbows, then reverse the whole path to return.

Focus: Keep the elbows still through the curl rather than letting them travel forward, and keep the ribs down through the overhead portion rather than arching the back. Control the bar on the way back down, which is where most of the work is.

Hollow body hold – bar overhead
3 sets20sBarbell/MatModerate
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Lie on the back holding a bar at arm's length above the chest, legs straight, lower back pressed firmly into the floor.

Movement: Lift the shoulders and legs a little off the floor into a shallow dish shape, bar held overhead, and hold.

Focus: Keep the lower back pressed to the floor at all times, and treat it lifting as the end of the set rather than something to push through. Hold the bar still rather than letting it drift back past the head, and breathe shallow and steady.

w/c 2 Nov 2026 · Squat & Hinge & Push▼
Goblet squat

Start: Hold a dumbbell or kettlebell close to your chest with both hands, elbows tucked down, feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out.

Movement: Sit the hips back and down into a squat, keeping the weight at the chest and the torso upright, then drive up through the heels to stand tall.

Focus: Keep the knees in line with the middle toes, never caving in, and the heels flat. Keep the chest up and the weight close, and squat only as deep as you can control comfortably.

3 x 8-12 · ~5kg
Romanian deadlift to shrug

Start: Stand tall holding the weight at the thighs, feet hip-width, knees soft, core braced.

Movement: Hinge the hips back and lower the weight down the legs, then drive the hips forward to stand and add a strong shoulder shrug at the top before lowering.

Focus: Keep the back flat through the hinge and let the hips do the work. Shrug straight up, no rolling the shoulders, and stay tall rather than leaning back.

3 x 8-12 · ~17.5kg
Z-press – BB

Start: Sit on the floor, legs straight out in front, a barbell at the shoulders, sitting tall, ribs down, core braced hard.

Movement: Press the bar overhead until the arms are straight, then lower to the shoulders under control while staying upright.

Focus: Keep sitting tall with the ribs down, not leaning back or arching, which the seated position exposes. Keep the shoulders down, and press within a comfortable overhead range.

3 x 8-12 · Moderate
Lateral raise

Start: Stand tall, a light weight in each hand at the sides, elbows softly bent, ribs down.

Movement: Raise the arms out to the sides to shoulder height, leading with the elbows, then lower under control.

Focus: Lead with the elbows and keep the shoulders down, not shrugging, raising only to shoulder height. Use a light weight, and control the lower rather than swinging.

3 x 8-12 each side · ~2kg
Hip abduction – standing band

Start: Stand with a band around the ankles or lower legs, holding a support, torso tall.

Movement: Take the working leg out to the side against the band, keeping it straight, then return under control.

Focus: Keep the leg straight and the torso tall, not leaning to lift, and the hips level. Lead with the heel, keep it slow, and feel the outer hip.

3 x 8-12 · Light
Renegade row

Start: Set up in a push-up position gripping two dumbbells, feet wide for stability, body in a straight line, core braced hard.

Movement: Row one dumbbell to the hip while balancing on the other, lower it, then row the other side.

Focus: Keep the hips level and square, resisting the twist as you row, which is the whole point. Keep the body in a straight line, brace hard, and control each row.

3 x 8-12 each side · ~2kg
w/c 2 Nov 2026 · Hinge & Pull & Carry▼
Deadlift – BB tempo

Start: Set up as for a conventional deadlift, feet hip-width, bar over mid-foot, flat back, chest up, core braced.

Movement: Lift the bar to standing with control, then lower it slowly over three to four seconds down the same close path, keeping tension the whole way.

Focus: Hold a flat back through the slow lower, the tempo is where the exercise is won or lost. Keep the bar close and don't let the back round as fatigue sets in on the descent.

3 x 6-10 · Moderate
Gorilla row

Start: Feet wide, a weight on the floor under each shoulder. Hinge over with a flat back and take hold of both, knees soft.

Movement: Row one weight up to the ribs while the other hand pushes down into its weight to hold you steady. Lower it, then row the other side. Keep alternating.

Focus: Both hands stay loaded the whole time, which is what makes it steadier than a single arm row. Hips and shoulders square, no twisting to get the weight up, back flat.

3 x 8-12 each side · ~2kg
Waiter carry – single arm

Start: Stand tall holding a weight overhead in one hand, arm straight, ribs down, core braced.

Movement: Walk forward with controlled steps for the set distance, keeping the weight stable overhead.

Focus: Keep the ribs down and don't arch the lower back to hold the weight up, staying tall. Keep the shoulder stable and the arm straight, and resist tipping to either side.

3 x 30m · Moderate
Biceps 21s

Start: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms forward, elbows pinned to the sides, ribs down.

Movement: Do seven curls through the bottom half, seven through the top half, then seven full curls, keeping the elbows still.

Focus: Keep the elbows pinned to the sides throughout and don't swing, even as fatigue builds. Keep the ribs down, and control each partial and full rep.

3 x 8-12 · ~2.5kg
Glute kickback – band

Start: Loop a band around your ankles or hold it under the standing foot. Stand tall, hands on a support for balance, slight bend in the standing knee.

Movement: Push one leg back against the band using the glute, keeping it fairly straight, then return with control.

Focus: Squeeze the glute at the back and keep the movement at the hip. Don't arch the lower back or swing the leg to cheat the range.

3 x 8-12 · Light
Side plank – with hip dip

Start: Hold a side plank, body in a straight line, shoulder over the elbow.

Movement: Lower the hips slowly towards the floor a short way, then lift back up to the straight line, controlled, for the set reps.

Focus: Control the dip and the lift with the side waist, keeping the body in line front to back. Don't let the hips sag at the bottom or the torso rotate, and keep the shoulder stacked.

3 x 8-12 each side · Bodyweight

w/c 26 Oct 2026 · Squat & Hinge & Push▼
Box squat – goblet

Start: Stand in front of a box at about parallel height holding a weight at the chest, feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out.

Movement: Sit the hips back and down to lightly touch the box, then drive up through the heels to stand tall, keeping the weight at the chest.

Focus: Keep the knees tracking over the toes and the heels down. Touch the box under control rather than dropping, and keep the chest up and the weight close throughout.

3 x 8-12 · Moderate
Power snatch – BB

Start: Stand with a barbell on the floor, feet hip-width, a wide grip, hinged with a flat back, core braced.

Movement: Drive explosively from the floor through the hips to pull the bar up and punch it overhead in one movement, catching in a partial dip, then lower under control.

Focus: Keep the back flat off the floor and drive from a sharp hip extension, keeping the bar close. Catch with the ribs down, the shoulder stable and the knees tracking over the feet, and control the lower.

3 x 6-10 · Moderate
Face pull – band, seated

Start: Sit tall, a band anchored in front at head height, a handle in each hand, arms extended forward, ribs down.

Movement: Pull the band towards the face, drawing the hands to the sides of the head with the elbows high, then return under control.

Focus: Lead with the elbows high and squeeze the shoulder blades, not shrugging up. Keep the ribs down and the neck relaxed, and control the return.

3 x 8-12 · Light
Calf raises – loaded single leg

Start: Stand on one foot, the ball of the foot on a step edge, a weight in the hand, holding a support with the other.

Movement: Rise up onto the toes as high as you comfortably can, then lower the heel slowly under control.

Focus: Rise and lower slowly and evenly, not bouncing, through the full comfortable range. Keep the ankle tracking straight, not rolling out, and control the lower.

3 x 8-12 each side · Light
Floor press – BB

Start: Lie on the floor under the bar, knees bent or legs straight, shoulder blades set, grip a little wider than shoulders.

Movement: Lower the bar until the upper arms rest lightly on the floor, pause briefly, then press back up to straight arms.

Focus: Keep the shoulder blades set and the elbows tucked to about 45 degrees. The floor limits the depth, which is easier on the shoulders, so let the triceps touch lightly and press without bouncing.

3 x 6-10 · ~5kg
Straight leg raises

Start: Lie on your back, legs straight, hands under the lower back or by the sides, ribs down.

Movement: Raise both straight legs towards the ceiling, then lower them slowly without letting the lower back arch.

Focus: Keep the lower back gently pressed down throughout, and stop lowering the moment it wants to arch. Move slowly, and bend the knees a little if the back lifts.

3 x 8-12 · Bodyweight

Stiff-leg deadlift – BB

Start: Stand tall with the bar at the thighs, feet hip-width, knees almost straight but not locked, shoulders back, core braced.

Movement: Push the hips back and lower the bar down the front of the legs with the knees kept still, feeling a strong hamstring stretch, then drive the hips forward to stand tall.

Focus: Keep the back flat throughout, never rounded, and only go as low as the flat back allows. With the knees nearly straight the stretch is strong, so control the range and keep the bar close to the legs.

3 x 6-10 · ~15kg
Pendlay row

Start: Hinge to a flat back with the torso near parallel, barbell on the floor, overhand grip, core braced.

Movement: Pull the bar explosively from the floor to the lower chest, then lower it back to the floor and reset each rep.

Focus: Keep the back flat and parallel throughout, never rising or rounding as you pull. Lead with the elbows, squeeze the shoulder blades, and reset the bar on the floor between reps.

3 x 8-12 · ~10kg
Double rack carry

Start: Stand tall with a weight racked at each shoulder, elbows tucked, ribs down, core braced.

Movement: Walk forward with controlled steps for the set distance, keeping the torso tall and steady.

Focus: Keep the ribs down and the torso tall, not arching under the front load. Keep the shoulders down and the elbows tucked, take steady steps, and brace the core.

3 x 30m · Moderate
Internal rotation – band

Start: Stand side-on to a band at elbow height, the near elbow pinned to the side and bent to 90 degrees, forearm out to the side.

Movement: Rotate the forearm inward across the body, keeping the elbow pinned, then return under control.

Focus: Keep the elbow glued to the side and move only the forearm. Keep the shoulder down and the ribs still, and control the return.

3 x 8-12 · Light
Hollow body hold – bar overhead

Start: Lie on the back holding a bar at arm's length above the chest, legs straight, lower back pressed firmly into the floor.

Movement: Lift the shoulders and legs a little off the floor into a shallow dish shape, bar held overhead, and hold.

Focus: Keep the lower back pressed to the floor at all times, and treat it lifting as the end of the set rather than something to push through. Hold the bar still rather than letting it drift back past the head, and breathe shallow and steady.

3 x 40s · Moderate
Glute bridge – march

Start: Hold a bridge at the top with the hips fully extended and level, feet hip-width, core braced.

Movement: Without letting the hips drop, lift one foot a few centimetres off the floor, set it down, then the other, in a slow march.

Focus: Keep the hips absolutely still and level, no rocking or dipping as the foot lifts. The glutes and core hold the position throughout.

3 x 8-12 · Bodyweight

Waiter carry – single arm

Movement: Walk forward with controlled steps for the set distance, keeping the weight stable overhead.

Focus: Keep the ribs down and don't arch the lower back to hold the weight up, staying tall. Keep the shoulder stable and the arm straight, and resist tipping to either side.

Power clean – BB

Start: Stand with a barbell on the floor, feet hip-width, hinged with a flat back, shins near the bar, core braced.

Movement: Drive explosively from the floor through the hips to pull the bar up and catch it at the shoulders in a partial dip, then lower under control.

Focus: Keep the back flat as the bar leaves the floor and drive from a sharp hip extension, not arm-pulling. Catch softly with the ribs down and knees tracking over the feet, and control the lower.

Bird-dog – weighted arm

Start: On all fours, a light weight in one hand or a cuff on the wrist, back flat and neutral, core braced.

Movement: Reach the weighted arm and the opposite leg out level with the body, hold briefly, then return and repeat, swapping as set.

Focus: Keep the hips and shoulders square and the back flat, resisting the twist the added weight encourages. Move slowly, and keep the reach to where the neutral spine holds.

Side plank – with hip dip

Movement: Lower the hips slowly towards the floor a short way, then lift back up to the straight line, controlled, for the set reps.

Goblet squat and reach

Start: Hold a weight at the chest, feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out.

Movement: Sit down into a squat and, at the bottom, reach the weight forward to help you sit upright, then draw it back to the chest and stand tall.

3 x 8-12 · Moderate
Romanian deadlift – BB

Start: Stand tall with a barbell held at the front of your thighs, hands just outside your legs, feet hip-width. Set the shoulders back, brace the core hard, and keep a soft bend in the knees.

Movement: Push the hips back and slide the bar down the front of your legs, keeping it in contact, until you feel a strong stretch in the hamstrings. Keep the knees still and the shins vertical. Drive the hips forward to stand tall and finish with the glutes.

Focus: The back stays flat from start to finish, never rounded. This is a hip hinge, not a squat, so the movement happens at the hips while the bar tracks close to the legs. Only lower as far as you can hold a flat back, and don't lean back or over-arch at the top.

3 x 6-10 · Moderate
V-sit ups

Start: Lie on your back, legs straight, arms overhead, ribs down.

Movement: Lift the torso and legs together to meet in a V, reaching towards the feet, then lower under control.

Focus: Lift from the core and keep the neck neutral, not straining the head forward. Lower under control without the back arching, and reduce the range if the back complains.

3 x 8-12 · Bodyweight
Hip row – BB

Start: Hinge forward with a flat back holding a barbell at arms' length, chest up, core braced, hips back.

Movement: Pull the bar towards the hips, driving the elbows back, then lower under control while holding the hinge.

Focus: Keep the back flat and the hinge steady throughout, not rising or rounding as you row. Lead with the elbows, squeeze the shoulder blades, and keep the shoulders down.

3 x 8-12 · Moderate
Floor press – BB

Start: Lie on the floor under the bar, knees bent or legs straight, shoulder blades set, grip a little wider than shoulders.

Movement: Lower the bar until the upper arms rest lightly on the floor, pause briefly, then press back up to straight arms.

Focus: Keep the shoulder blades set and the elbows tucked to about 45 degrees. The floor limits the depth, which is easier on the shoulders, so let the triceps touch lightly and press without bouncing.

3 x 6-10 · Moderate
w/c 12 Oct 2026 · Hinge & Carry & Rotate▼
Deadlift – sumo BB

Start: Take a wide stance, toes out, bar over mid-foot. Sit the hips back and down to grip inside the legs, arms straight, chest up, flat back, shoulders over the bar.

Movement: Drive through the legs and push the knees out, standing the bar up close to the body until the hips lock out tall. Push the hips back to lower along the same line under control.

Focus: Keep the chest up and the back flat, never rounded. Drive the knees out over the toes and take the effort in the legs and hips. Keep the bar close and don't lean back at the top.

3 x 6-10 · Moderate
Double rack carry

Start: Stand tall with a weight racked at each shoulder, elbows tucked, ribs down, core braced.

Movement: Walk forward with controlled steps for the set distance, keeping the torso tall and steady.

Focus: Keep the ribs down and the torso tall, not arching under the front load. Keep the shoulders down and the elbows tucked, take steady steps, and brace the core.

3 x 30m · Moderate
Foot anchored wood chops low to high

Start: Anchor a resistance band under one foot and hold the other end in both hands down by the opposite hip, feet hip-width, knees soft, core braced.

Movement: Sweep the band up and across from the low hip to above the opposite shoulder, rotating through the trunk, then return under control.

Focus: Drive the rotation through the hips and trunk together, ribs down, and control the band back down. Don't yank with the arms or twist the lower back.

3 x 8-12 each side · Light
Bent-over row – BB

Start: Hinge forward with a flat back holding a barbell at arms' length, chest up, hips back, core braced.

Movement: Pull the bar towards the lower chest or upper abdomen, driving the elbows back, then lower under control.

Focus: Keep the back flat and the hinge steady, not rising or rounding as you row, this protects the lower back. Lead with the elbows, squeeze the shoulder blades, and control the lower.

3 x 6-10 · Moderate
Hollow body hold – bar overhead

Start: Lie on the back holding a bar at arm's length above the chest, legs straight, lower back pressed firmly into the floor.

Movement: Lift the shoulders and legs a little off the floor into a shallow dish shape, bar held overhead, and hold.

Focus: Keep the lower back pressed to the floor at all times, and treat it lifting as the end of the set rather than something to push through. Hold the bar still rather than letting it drift back past the head, and breathe shallow and steady.

3 x 40s · Moderate

Squat – racked

Start: Hold a weight in each hand racked at the shoulders, feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out, core braced.

Movement: Sit the hips back and down into a squat, keeping the chest up, then drive through the heels to stand tall.

Focus: Keep the knees tracking over the toes and the heels down throughout. Keep the chest up and the core braced, and go only as deep as your knees and hips stay comfortable.

3 x 8-10 · Moderate
Romanian deadlift to shrug

Start: Stand tall holding the weight at the thighs, feet hip-width, knees soft, core braced.

Movement: Hinge the hips back and lower the weight down the legs, then drive the hips forward to stand and add a strong shoulder shrug at the top before lowering.

Focus: Keep the back flat through the hinge and let the hips do the work. Shrug straight up, no rolling the shoulders, and stay tall rather than leaning back.

3 x 8-12 · Moderate
Clean and press – BB

Start: Stand with a barbell on the floor, feet hip-width, hinged with a flat back, shins near the bar, core braced.

Movement: Drive the bar up from the floor to the shoulders in one movement, then press it overhead, before lowering under control.

Focus: Keep the back flat as the bar leaves the floor, driving with the legs, then keep the ribs down and glutes squeezed on the press, not arching. Move smoothly through each phase, and control the lower.

3 x 6-8 · Moderate
Pendlay row

Start: Hinge to a flat back with the torso near parallel, barbell on the floor, overhand grip, core braced.

Movement: Pull the bar explosively from the floor to the lower chest, then lower it back to the floor and reset each rep.

Focus: Keep the back flat and parallel throughout, never rising or rounding as you pull. Lead with the elbows, squeeze the shoulder blades, and reset the bar on the floor between reps.

3 x 8-12 · Moderate
Renegade row

Start: Set up in a push-up position gripping two dumbbells, feet wide for stability, body in a straight line, core braced hard.

Movement: Row one dumbbell to the hip while balancing on the other, lower it, then row the other side.

Focus: Keep the hips level and square, resisting the twist as you row, which is the whole point. Keep the body in a straight line, brace hard, and control each row.

3 x 8-12 each side · Moderate
w/c 5 Oct 2026 · Hinge & Carry & Rotate▼
Stiff-leg deadlift – BB

Start: Stand tall with the bar at the thighs, feet hip-width, knees almost straight but not locked, shoulders back, core braced.

Movement: Push the hips back and lower the bar down the front of the legs with the knees kept still, feeling a strong hamstring stretch, then drive the hips forward to stand tall.

Focus: Keep the back flat throughout, never rounded, and only go as low as the flat back allows. With the knees nearly straight the stretch is strong, so control the range and keep the bar close to the legs.

3 x 8-10 · Moderate
Waiter carry – single arm

Start: Stand tall holding a weight overhead in one hand, arm straight, ribs down, core braced.

Movement: Walk forward with controlled steps for the set distance, keeping the weight stable overhead.

Focus: Keep the ribs down and don't arch the lower back to hold the weight up, staying tall. Keep the shoulder stable and the arm straight, and resist tipping to either side.

3 x 30m · Moderate
Overhead press – seated

Start: Sit tall on a bench with back support, a weight in each hand at shoulder height, elbows under the wrists, ribs down.

Movement: Press the the weights overhead until the arms are straight, then lower them back to shoulder height under control.

Focus: Keep the ribs down and the back against the support, not arching to press. Keep the shoulders down away from the ears, and lower under control to a comfortable shoulder range.

3 x 8-10 · ~5kg
Bird-dog – weighted arm

Start: On all fours, a light weight in one hand or a cuff on the wrist, back flat and neutral, core braced.

Movement: Reach the weighted arm and the opposite leg out level with the body, hold briefly, then return and repeat, swapping as set.

Focus: Keep the hips and shoulders square and the back flat, resisting the twist the added weight encourages. Move slowly, and keep the reach to where the neutral spine holds.

3 x 8-12 each side · Moderate
Side plank – with hip dip

Start: Hold a side plank, body in a straight line, shoulder over the elbow.

Movement: Lower the hips slowly towards the floor a short way, then lift back up to the straight line, controlled, for the set reps.

Focus: Control the dip and the lift with the side waist, keeping the body in line front to back. Don't let the hips sag at the bottom or the torso rotate, and keep the shoulder stacked.

3 x 8-12 each side · Bodyweight

Thruster

Start: Stand tall, a weight at each shoulder, feet hip-width, ribs down, core braced.

Movement: Squat down, then drive up and use that momentum to press the weights overhead, before returning to the shoulders.

Focus: Drive up from the legs and let the momentum carry the press, keeping the ribs down. Keep the weight light enough to control overhead, and control the return to the shoulders.

3 x 8-12 · 3kg
Single arm overhead press

Start: Stand tall, a weight at one shoulder, feet hip-width, ribs down, core braced against the offset load.

Movement: Press the weight overhead until the arm is straight, then lower back to the shoulder under control.

Focus: Keep the ribs down and resist leaning away from the weight, keeping the torso upright. Keep the shoulder down away from the ear, and press within a comfortable range.

3 x 8-12 each side · 5kg
Calf raises – loaded single leg

Start: Stand on one foot, the ball of the foot on a step edge, a weight in the hand, holding a support with the other.

Movement: Rise up onto the toes as high as you comfortably can, then lower the heel slowly under control.

Focus: Rise and lower slowly and evenly, not bouncing, through the full comfortable range. Keep the ankle tracking straight, not rolling out, and control the lower.

3 x 8-12 each side · Light
Wrist flexion – supported

Start: Sit with the forearm resting along a thigh or bench, palm facing up, wrist and hand free over the edge, holding a light weight.

Movement: Curl the knuckles up towards the forearm, hold briefly at the top, then lower slowly to where the range stays pain-free rather than letting the weight drop the wrist back.

Focus: Move only at the wrist and only through the range that stays comfortable. The forearm never lifts off its support. Start lighter than feels necessary and add range before adding weight.

3 x 8-12 · Light
Tricep extension – overhead

Start: Stand or sit tall, holding a weight in both hands behind the head, elbows pointing up, ribs down.

Movement: Straighten the arms to press the weight overhead, then lower it slowly behind the head, keeping the elbows still and pointing up.

Focus: Move only at the elbows, keeping the upper arms still and close to the head. Keep the ribs down and don't arch the lower back to press the weight up.

3 x 10 · 3kg
w/c 28 Sep 2026 · Hinge & Pull▼
Squat press

Start: Stand tall, a weight at each shoulder, feet hip-width, ribs down, core braced.

Movement: Squat down, then drive up and press the weights overhead, before returning to the shoulders.

Focus: Keep the knees tracking over the feet in the squat and the ribs down on the press, not arching. Flow the drive into the press, and control the return.

3 x 8-12 · Moderate
Gorilla row

Start: Feet wide, a weight on the floor under each shoulder. Hinge over with a flat back and take hold of both, knees soft.

Movement: Row one weight up to the ribs while the other hand pushes down into its weight to hold you steady. Lower it, then row the other side. Keep alternating.

Focus: Both hands stay loaded the whole time, which is what makes it steadier than a single arm row. Hips and shoulders square, no twisting to get the weight up, back flat.

3 x 8-12 each side · Moderate
Tricep kickback – single arm

Start: Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back, one hand supported on a bench or a thigh, weight in the other hand, upper arm tucked in against the ribs and elbow bent.

Movement: Straighten the elbow to take the weight back until the arm is straight, hold for a moment, then lower under control.

Focus: Keep the upper arm still and pinned to the side. Move only at the elbow, and don't let the shoulder swing the weight back.

3 x 8-12 each side · Light
Squat and sweep

Start: Stand a little wider than hip-width holding a med ball in both hands at chest height, knees soft, core braced.

Movement: Squat and sweep the ball low toward one foot, then rise and sweep it up and over to the opposite side in one flowing arc. Alternate sides.

Focus: As you squat, sweep the ball down and across toward one foot, then sweep it up and overhead as you stand and shift toward the other side. Keep the movement continuous and the spine long, matching depth and reach to comfort.

3 x 8-12 each side · Moderate
Glute bridge – march

Start: Hold a bridge at the top with the hips fully extended and level, feet hip-width, core braced.

Movement: Without letting the hips drop, lift one foot a few centimetres off the floor, set it down, then the other, in a slow march.

Focus: Keep the hips absolutely still and level, no rocking or dipping as the foot lifts. The glutes and core hold the position throughout.

3 x 8-12 · Bodyweight

Curl and press

Movement: Curl both weights to the shoulders, then press them overhead until the arms are straight, then reverse both to return.

Focus: Keep the ribs down through the press rather than arching the back, and keep the shoulders down away from the ears. Control the curl and the press, and do not let the knees or hips help the weight up.

Lateral raises

Movement: Raise the arms out to the sides to shoulder height, leading with the elbows, then lower under control.

Standing external rotation – arm tucked

Movement: Rotate the forearm outward to the side, keeping the elbow pinned, then lower under control.

Focus: Keep the elbow pinned to the side and move only the forearm. Keep the shoulder down and use a light weight, controlling the whole range.

Front raises

Movement: Raise the arms forward and up to shoulder height with straight arms, then lower under control.

Focus: Lead with a straight arm and keep the shoulders down, not shrugging, raising only to shoulder height. Use a light weight, don't lean back, and control the lower rather than swinging.

Prone Y raise

Movement: Raise the arms off the floor towards the Y position, squeezing the lower shoulder blades, then lower under control.

Overhead press – Arnold

Start: Sit or stand tall, dumbbells held in front at shoulder height, palms facing you, elbows down, ribs down.

Movement: Press overhead while rotating the palms to face forward, straightening the arms, then reverse the rotation as you lower back down.

Focus: Keep the ribs down and the lower back neutral through the press and rotation. Keep the shoulders down, control the twist, and stay within a comfortable shoulder range.

Biceps 21s

Movement: Do seven curls through the bottom half, seven through the top half, then seven full curls, keeping the elbows still.

Focus: Keep the elbows pinned to the sides throughout and don't swing, even as fatigue builds. Keep the ribs down, and control each partial and full rep.

Front raises – slow eccentric

Movement: Raise the arms forward to shoulder height, then lower slowly over three to four seconds under control.

Focus: Keep the shoulders down and the arms straight, then control the slow lower. Use a light weight, raise only to shoulder height, and don't lean back.

Prone T raise

Movement: Raise the arms out to the sides, squeezing the shoulder blades together, then lower under control.

Focus: Squeeze the shoulder blades together and keep the shoulders down, not shrugging. Keep the neck long, use a light weight, and control the lower.

Shoulder press – Arnold press

Start: Sit or stand tall, dumbbells held in front at shoulder height, palms facing you, elbows down, ribs down.

Movement: Press overhead while rotating the palms to face forward, straightening the arms, then reverse the rotation as you lower back down.

Focus: Keep the ribs down and the lower back neutral through the press and rotation. Keep the shoulders down, control the twist, and stay within a comfortable shoulder range.

3 x 10 · ~2kg
Lateral raises – slow eccentric

Start: Stand tall, a light dumbbell in each hand at the sides, elbows softly bent, ribs down.

Movement: Raise the arms out to shoulder height, then lower slowly over three to four seconds under control.

Focus: Lead with the elbows and keep the shoulders down, not shrugging, then control the slow lower. Use a light weight, and raise only to shoulder height.

3 x 12 · ~2kg
Full can exercise

Start: Stand tall, arms down and slightly out in front at about 30 degrees, thumbs pointing up, light or no weight.

Movement: Raise the arms to shoulder height in that line with thumbs up, then lower under control.

Focus: Lead with the thumbs and keep the shoulders down, not shrugging, raising only to shoulder height. Use a light weight, and control the lower.

3 x 12 · ~2kg
Standing external rotation – arm raised

Start: Stand tall with the upper arm out to the side at shoulder height, elbow bent to 90 degrees, forearm pointing forward, holding a light weight.

Movement: Rotate the forearm up towards the ceiling, keeping the upper arm parallel to the floor, then lower under control to the start.

Focus: Keep the upper arm still and level at shoulder height, and move only the forearm. Go very light, keep the shoulder down away from the ear, and stop short of anything that pinches at the top.

3 x 12 each · ~2kg
Double rack carry

Start: Stand tall with a weight racked at each shoulder, elbows tucked, ribs down, core braced.

Movement: Walk forward with controlled steps for the set distance, keeping the torso tall and steady.

Focus: Keep the ribs down and the torso tall, not arching under the front load. Keep the shoulders down and the elbows tucked, take steady steps, and brace the core.

3 x 25m · Moderate
Renegade row

Start: Set up in a push-up position gripping two dumbbells, feet wide for stability, body in a straight line, core braced hard.

Movement: Row one dumbbell to the hip while balancing on the other, lower it, then row the other side.

Focus: Keep the hips level and square, resisting the twist as you row, which is the whole point. Keep the body in a straight line, brace hard, and control each row.

3 x 8 each · Moderate

Waiter carry – bilateral

Movement: Walk forward with controlled steps for the set distance, keeping the weights stable overhead.

3 x 20m · Moderate
Cross-body carry

Movement: Walk forward with controlled steps for the set distance, keeping the torso tall and steady.

Focus: Resist the offset pull from both weights, keeping the shoulders and hips level and the ribs down. Brace hard, take steady steps, and stay tall.

Chest fly

Movement: Open the arms out to the sides in an arc to a comfortable stretch, then bring them back together above the chest.

Floor press – single arm

Focus: Let the elbow touch the floor gently each rep rather than crashing down, and keep the shoulder blade set. Because it is one side at a time, brace the trunk so it does not twist toward the working arm.

Start: Lie face down on a bench or mat with the arms hanging down off the edge, thumbs up, light or no weight.

Movement: Raise both arms straight out to the sides to shoulder height, squeezing the shoulder blades together, then lower under control.

Focus: Squeeze the shoulder blades together at the top and keep the shoulders down, not shrugging. Keep the neck long, use a light weight, and control the lower.

3 x 12 · Light
w/c 10 Aug 2026 · Range & Control▼
Shoulder press – around the clock, single arm

Start: Stand tall, a light weight at one shoulder, ribs down, core braced.

Movement: Press the weight overhead and move it through small controlled positions (front, side, angles) as set, keeping the arm working, then return.

Focus: Keep the ribs down and the core braced so the back doesn't arch as the arm moves. Keep the shoulder down, move slowly and controlled, and use a light weight given the changing angles.

3 x 8 each · Light
Straight arm raise – single arm

Start: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in one hand at the thigh, arm straight, ribs down, core braced.

Movement: Raise the dumbbell forward and up to about shoulder height with a straight arm, then lower under control. Finish the reps, then swap sides.

Focus: Lead with a straight arm and keep the shoulder down, not shrugging, raising only to shoulder height. Working one side at a time shows up any left-to-right difference, so match both sides. Keep the ribs down and don't lean away.

3 x 12 each · Moderate
Scapular clock

Start: Stand or sit tall, arms relaxed, ribs down, focusing on the shoulder blades.

Movement: Move the shoulder blades slowly through positions like a clock face: up, down, back, forward and the points between, in a controlled sweep.

Focus: Move only the shoulder blades through a comfortable range, keeping the neck relaxed. Move slowly and deliberately, and keep the shrug-up position gentle.

3 x 8 each way · Bodyweight
Scapular retraction and depression

Start: Sit or stand tall, arms relaxed at the sides, ribs down, neck long.

Movement: Draw the shoulder blades back and down together, hold briefly, then release under control.

Focus: Squeeze the shoulder blades back and down, away from the ears, not shrugging. Keep the neck long and the ribs down, and move slowly and deliberately.

3 x 12 · Bodyweight
Rotator cuff – side-lying external rotation

Start: Lie on your side, the top arm's elbow pinned to the ribs and bent to 90 degrees, a light dumbbell held with the forearm across the tummy.

Movement: Rotate the forearm upward, opening the hand towards the ceiling, keeping the elbow pinned, then lower under control.

Focus: Keep the elbow pinned to the ribs and move only the forearm. Use a very light weight, keep the shoulder down, and control the slow lower.

3 x 12 each · Light
Sleeper stretch

Start: Lie on your side, the bottom arm out in front at shoulder height, elbow bent to 90 degrees, forearm up.

Movement: Use the top hand to gently press the bottom forearm down towards the floor until you feel a stretch at the back of the shoulder, then hold.

Focus: Press only to a gentle, comfortable stretch, never forcing, as this shoulder position is sensitive. Keep the shoulder blade settled, breathe, and back off at any pinch.

3 x 30s each · Bodyweight

w/c 3 Aug 2026 · Press & Scap▼
Shoulder press – seated DB

Start: Sit tall on a bench with back support, a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, elbows under the wrists, ribs down.

Movement: Press the dumbbells overhead until the arms are straight, then lower them back to shoulder height under control.

Focus: Keep the ribs down and the back against the support, not arching to press. Keep the shoulders down away from the ears, and lower under control to a comfortable shoulder range.

3 x 10 · ~2 x 2kg
Lateral raises – DB

Start: Stand tall, a light dumbbell in each hand at the sides, elbows softly bent, ribs down.

Movement: Raise the arms out to the sides to shoulder height, leading with the elbows, then lower under control.

Focus: Lead with the elbows and keep the shoulders down, not shrugging, raising only to shoulder height. Use a light weight, and control the lower rather than swinging.

3 x 12 · ~2kg
Side-lying external rotation – progressive load

Start: Lie on your side, the top elbow pinned to the ribs and bent to 90 degrees, a light dumbbell held, forearm across the tummy.

Movement: Rotate the forearm up towards the ceiling, keeping the elbow pinned, then lower slowly under control.

Focus: Keep the elbow pinned and move only the forearm, progressing the weight only slightly at a time. Keep the shoulder down and control the slow lower.

3 x 12 each · Light
Prone W raise

Start: Lie face down, elbows bent and tucked towards the sides so the arms form a W, thumbs up, light or no weight.

Movement: Raise the arms into the W, drawing the elbows down and in and squeezing the shoulder blades, then lower under control.

Focus: Draw the elbows down and in, squeezing the shoulder blades, not shrugging up. Keep the neck long, use a light weight, and control the lower.

3 x 12 · Light
Wall push-up plus

Start: Stand facing a wall, hands flat on it at shoulder height and width, arms straight, body in a line leaning in slightly.

Movement: Bend the elbows to bring the chest towards the wall, press back, then at the top push a little further to round the upper back (the plus), then relax.

Focus: Keep the body in a straight line, not sagging at the hips. Keep the shoulders down, and on the plus let the shoulder blades spread rather than shrugging up.

3 x 12 · Bodyweight
Bicep curls

Start: Stand tall, a dumbbell in each hand at the sides, elbows pinned to the ribs, ribs down, core braced.

Movement: Curl the weights up towards the shoulders, keeping the elbows still, then lower under control.

Focus: Keep the elbows pinned to the sides and don't swing the body to lift. Keep the ribs down, and control the lower rather than dropping.

3 x 12 · Light
w/c 3 Aug 2026 · Range & Cuff▼
Arnold press

Start: Sit tall, dumbbells held in front at shoulder height, palms facing you, elbows down, ribs down.

Movement: Press overhead while rotating the palms to face forward, straightening the arms, then reverse the rotation as you lower back down.

Focus: Keep the ribs down and the lower back neutral through the press and rotation. Keep the shoulders down, control the twist, and stay within a comfortable shoulder range.

3 x 10 · Moderate
Wall slides

Start: Stand with your back, head and arms against a wall, feet a few centimetres out so the lower back stays flat, elbows bent to 90 degrees in a goalpost.

Movement: Slide the arms slowly up towards overhead keeping every point of contact, then slide back down under control.

Focus: Keep the whole back and both arms on the wall throughout. The moment the lower back arches or the hands lift away is your limit, so work just short of it, and breathe steadily.

3 x 10 · Bodyweight
Full can exercise

Start: Stand tall, arms down and slightly out in front at about 30 degrees, thumbs pointing up, light weights.

Movement: Raise the arms to shoulder height in that line with thumbs up, then lower under control.

Focus: Lead with the thumbs and keep the shoulders down, not shrugging, raising only to shoulder height. Use a light weight, and control the lower.

3 x 12 · ~2kg
Prone scaption

Start: Lie face down, arms reaching down and out at about 30 degrees from the body, thumbs up, light or no weight.

Movement: Raise the arms in that scaption line, squeezing the shoulder blades, then lower under control.

Focus: Lead with the thumbs and keep the shoulders down, not shrugging. Keep the neck long, use a light weight, and control the lower.

3 x 12 · Light
Side-lying internal rotation

Start: Lie on your side, the bottom arm's elbow pinned to the ribs and bent to 90 degrees, a light dumbbell held, forearm out.

Movement: Rotate the forearm up towards the tummy, keeping the elbow pinned, then lower under control.

Focus: Keep the elbow pinned to the ribs and move only the forearm. Use a very light weight, keep the shoulder down, and control the slow lower.

3 x 12 each · Light
Isometric external rotation

Start: Stand tall, upper arm pinned to the side, elbow bent to 90 degrees, forearm across the front, ribs down.

Movement: Press the back of the hand outward against a fixed resistance (a wall or doorframe) and hold the effort for the set time.

Focus: Keep the elbow pinned to the side and the shoulder down, not shrugging. Keep the ribs down, press gently and steadily, and breathe rather than holding your breath.

3 x 20s each · Bodyweight
